input.subject: Rat activity – proofing works update needed – 14 Mosswold Crescent (ref R/018)
input.body:
Dear Mr Vale,

Re: rat activity in the kitchen at 14 Mosswold Crescent, Brindlewick, ZZ1 1ZZ (ref R/018).

On 18 August we noted that you would arrange these works directly. Your tenant tells us pest control removed its equipment on 7 September, but the contractor she understood was coming on 8 September to seal the openings did not attend. We have not received confirmation that any proofing work has been done.

As rats were getting into the kitchen, please could you reply with:
1. the name of the contractor carrying out the proofing work and the new appointment date; and
2. a copy of the pest controller's report, if you have it.

If you would rather Northbridge Lettings arranged the proofing, please tell us and we will send you a quote for approval. You are also welcome to call us back.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance, Northbridge Lettings
